label: Engraving and woodcut
description: Old-print illustration: fine engraved hatching or bold woodcut marks, sepia and ink on aged paper, brought to life.
suits: history, scripture, the classics, the history of science, myths and legends
image: antique engraving illustration with fine cross-hatched linework and stippling, or bold woodcut carving marks, dark ink on warm aged paper, occasional muted hand-tinted colour, the look of a plate from an old printed book
light: light and shade built entirely from the density of hatching, strong chiaroscuro
camera: stately: slow pans across the plate, measured push-ins onto detail
motion: the engraving comes alive: hatched water ripples, smoke curls, figures move with dignity, the line texture stays consistent and printed
avoid: photorealism, 3D render, smooth gradients, bright modern colour
